title: Homckach's Random Stuff
description: Adds bosses, weapons and mechanisms with nice progression, advancements will help you figure it ou
body:
**Geckolib, AttributeFix and Armor Unlocked are required.**

This mod adds a lot of things: bosses, structures, mechanisms, mobs, weapons, guns, powerful tnts and advancements. It currently has:

- 4 Bosses
- 13 New weapons and 5 guns
- 22 Advancements
- New structure to explore
- 7 Crafting stations
- 5 TNTs, 3 of them are REALLY powerful
- 9 Musics disc  
And much more. This mod is focused on making mechanisms and defeating bosses. JEI is recommended. A tiny bit inspired by OreSpawn. This is my first serious mod that im uploading, hope you like it.
